- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Evidence remains thin for kinds of changes tested only once.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Centered Layout Home Intro Redesign: Redesign the home_intro screen into a centered layout highlighting essential desktop pet interaction controls. (why: Support receives multiple emails regarding confusion on how to control or hide pets after setup; a centered layout focuses attention directly on core controls.)
1: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Freedom Copy Update: Update headline and body copy on choose_path screen to emphasize that users can change or customize their setup path later. (why: Choose path has a high mean completion time (514s), showing users stall due to decision hesitation.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Sign-In Existing Pet Sync Reassurance Component: Add a clear text component on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that signing in restores previous pets and progress. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) complained about missing pets or reset data after signing back in.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Loading Explanation: Update headline and body on the waiting screen to clarify that the system is building the desktop pet window overlay. (why: 3 support emails reported pets failing to appear on the desktop; setting clear expectations during loading reduces user anxiety.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Two Column Photo Upload Screen Redesign: Redesign the photo upload step into a two-column layout separating photo selection from live pet preview display. (why: Support reported 3 custom pet creation issues; cleaner visual separation helps users upload and verify custom pet photos correctly.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Pet Drag and Drop Positioning Hint: Add a visual hint to the home intro screen showing users how to click and drag their pet anywhere on screen. (why: Users reported confusion regarding how to position or interact with their pet on the desktop post-onboarding.)
6: [choose_path, redesign] Stage Layout Story Introduction Redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen into a stage layout highlighting key features in a framed showcase. (why: A stage layout creates a polished initial impression, encouraging users to progress into path selection.)

scores.note: Finish step loses 19% of users and support emails report control confusion; finish redesigns show modest positive lift (+1.0% across 5 tests) but require redesign work.
Choose path has high drop-off and duration, though evidence is mostly funnel-based; choose_path copy changes show weak historical gains (+0.2%).
Top support theme (8 emails) targets sign-in data reset fears; sign_in copy changes historically show slight negative average, but copy change is cheap and highly relevant to feedback.
Home step has lower drop-off (7.9%), but wait_info changes have a highly reliable track record (+0.4% over 13 tests) and directly address reported support issues.
Adoption step loses 18.1% of users and support reports photo issues; adoption redesigns consistently perform well (+1.1% across 7 tests), though cost is high.
Finish hints are proven winners (+4.0% across 3 tests, winning 2/3) and directly address user confusion noted in support complaints.
Choose path step drops 20.6%, but choose_path redesigns historically perform poorly (-1.6% across 3 tests) and lack direct support mail evidence.
